==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
From {{der|en|la|collāpsus}} (past participle of {{m|la|collābor}}).

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|a=RP,GA,CA|/kəˈlæps/|q2=also|/klæps/}}
** {{homophones|en|claps|qq=monosyllabic}}
** {{audio|en|en-us-collapse.ogg|a=Southern California}}
** {{audio|en|en-au-collapse.ogg|a=Queensland}}
* {{IPA|en|a=NZ|/kəˈlɛps/}}
* {{IPA|en|a=Indic|/kɵˈlæps/|/kəˈlæps/}}
* {{rhymes|en|æps|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[break]] [[apart]] and [[fall]] [[down]] [[suddenly]]; to [[cave in]].
#: {{ux|en|The wall '''collapsed''' when it was hit by the wrecking ball.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1843|author=Samuel Maunder|title=The Scientific and Literary Treasury
|passage=A balloon '''collapses''' when the gas escapes from it.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[cease]] to [[function]] due to a sudden [[breakdown]]; to fail suddenly and completely.
#: {{syn|en|slump}} 
#: {{ux|en|[[pyramid scheme|Pyramid schemes]] tend to generate profits for a while and then '''collapse'''.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[fold]] [[compact]]ly.
#: {{syn|en|telescope}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|figurative}} To [[conflate]], to [[ignore]] the [[distinction]]s between.
# {{lb|en|transitive|computing}} In a [[hierarchical]] [[list]] (such as a [[directory]] tree or [[table of contents]]), to [[hide]] the subentries of (an [[entry]]).
#: {{ant|en|expand}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|cricket}} To suffer a [[batting collapse]].
#: {{ux|en|Immediately after his wicket the team '''collapsed''' for 69.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[cause]] something to collapse.
#: {{ux|en|[[hurry up|Hurry up]] and '''collapse''' the tent so we can get moving.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To pass out and fall to the floor or ground, as from exhaustion or other illness; to [[faint]].
#: {{syn|en|slump}} 
#: {{ux|en|The exhausted singer '''collapsed''' on stage and had to be taken to the hospital.}}
